settings.heading: Get Rewarded with Brickline Rewards. It's Free!
settings.signin_text: I have a Brickline Account and I'm already a Rewards Member

settings.question: Is Brickline Rewards really free to join?
settings.answer: Yes — membership is completely free, with no tiers or spending limits to unlock the basics. Sign up in-store or online in under a minute.

settings.question: How many points do I earn per purchase?
settings.answer: Silver members earn 1 point, Gold earns 2, and Platinum earns 3 for every ₱100 spent, both in-store and online.

settings.question: Do my points expire?
settings.answer: Points remain valid for 24 months from the date they were earned, as long as your account stays active.

settings.question: Can I use points and a discount code together?
settings.answer: Yes, points redemptions can be combined with most promotional discount codes at checkout.

settings.question: How do I redeem my rewards?
settings.answer: Visit the Rewards Centre in your account to browse available rewards and redeem points instantly online or in-store.

settings.heading: What is Brickline Rewards Loyalty Program?
settings.body: Free to join with no tiers or limits, Brickline Rewards is a loyalty program where you earn points on each purchase when shopping with us.

settings.title: It's free to be a member
settings.body: Sign up online or in-store and start collecting points. You'll also get access to exclusive items and pre-release collections.

settings.title: Collect 3 points for every ₱100 spent
settings.body: All members earn points on every purchase, based on their tier. Silver earns 1 point, Gold earns 2, and Platinum earns 3 for every ₱100 spent.

settings.title: Get access to online rewards
settings.body: Get access to the online Rewards Centre, where you can use your points for discounts and access exclusive rewards only available to members.

settings.title: Enjoy early access
settings.body: Enjoy early access to some of our most desirable products, invitations to special events, and members-only promotions like Double Points weekends.

settings.heading: Start Today And Build Your Balance Your Way
